title: A default Technician (with Work order lines Create & Edit) can bulk-complete another tech's line via Set Line Status
custom_preconds:
1. A staff user is on the default Technician role, which has the Work order lines Create & Edit permission.
  2. A work order has a line in Authorized status assigned to a different technician (or unassigned).

custom_steps_separated.content: Log in as the default Technician.
custom_steps_separated.expected: The work orders list is accessible.

custom_steps_separated.content: Open the work order that has the authorized line assigned to another technician.
custom_steps_separated.expected: The Lines tab opens and the line row is shown with an Authorized status badge.

custom_steps_separated.content: Open the three-dot bulk actions menu and click Set Line Status.
custom_steps_separated.expected: The status submenu opens; only the Complete option is shown for technicians.
There is no access-restricted error and the line status changes to Complete.

viu_status: Blocked-UI: needs multiple lines assigned to a DIFFERENT technician plus the Set Line Status bulk control; Set Line Status was not present on the test WO for the Technician role. Requires seeding another tech-s lines + reaching the bulk Set Line Status action.
evidence: Reworded; SV-ref/URL/403 jargon stripped. Needs live UI.
